name: folio
description: Folio — plataforma de insights UX (pesquisas + testes de usabilidade)

scripts.postinstall: cd server && npm install && cd ../web && npm install
scripts.build: cd server && npm run build && cd ../web && npm run build
scripts.db:setup: cd server && npx prisma migrate dev --name init && npm run seed
scripts.db:reset: cd server && npx prisma migrate reset --force
